newsitem.title: BRAZIL: CVRD costing Brazil people 430 mln reais - Kandir.
newsitem.headline: CVRD costing Brazil people 430 mln reais - Kandir.

text.p: Brazilian Planning Minister Antonio Kandir said the government's 51 percent stake in state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) was costing the Brazilian people around 430 million reais ($413.5 million) a year.
He said assuming that CVRD was worth 10 billion reais ($9.6 billion) the government would earn at least 5 billion reais ($4.8 billion) "in the worst case scenario" with the privatization of CVRD.

"CVRD currently pays around 70 million reais ($67.3 million) in dividends a year to the government," Kandir said. "If these 5 billion reais ($4.8 billion), which are the property of the Brazilian people, were not invested in CVRD shares but anywhere else the return on the investment would be of at least 500 million reais ($480.8 million)."
He said CVRD would be privatized in the first quarter of 1997 and the government expected to earn at least 10 billion reais ($9.6 billion) in privatization receipts next year.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
